description: Ruth Kelleher has received a call from Marian Prowse about the deposit deadline. Ruth is aware that the deposit must be in Marian's account by end of Wednesday 16th September. Ruth has not yet paid the deposit herself and is waiting to see how the group will handle it.
Dev Sandhu has expressed enthusiasm for the trip twice in the thread but has not yet paid any deposit. He is aware of the deadline.
Nina Achebe has not replied to the thread about the trip. She is aware of the deposit requirement but has not communicated her decision.
Marian Prowse is holding the week for the group until end of Wednesday 16th September. She has not yet received any deposit.

Ruth sends a group message to Dev and Nina: 'Hi both, just a reminder that Marian needs the £600 deposit by end of Wednesday to hold Cove Cottage for half-term. That's £200 each. Can you both confirm you can transfer your share by then? I'll sort mine too, but I don't want to be the one covering anyone else this time.'
Dev Sandhu notices the group message from Ruth on his phone.
Dev sends a reply to the group message: 'Sorry, I'm going to have to drop out. My car needed a new clutch and I can't spare £200 until payday. I hope you find someone else.'
Dev's reply arrives on Ruth's phone, available for her to see when she next checks.
Dev's reply arrives on Nina Achebe's phone, available for her to see when she next checks.
Nina's phone buzzes with the group message from Ruth and Dev's reply, but she is busy helping her mum settle for the night and does not check her phone immediately.

Ruth sends a follow-up message to Dev and Nina: 'Hi, just checking if you saw my message about the deposit for Cove Cottage. We need £200 each by Wednesday. Can you confirm if you can do it? I need to know so I can decide what to do.'
Ruth's follow-up message arrives on Dev's phone, available for him to see when he next checks.
Ruth checks her phone and sees Dev's reply that he is dropping out.
Ruth sends a message to Nina: 'Dev just said he can't do it due to car repairs. Are you still able to pay your £200? I could cover Dev's share but only if you're definitely in. Let me know ASAP.'
Ruth's message arrives on Nina Achebe's phone, available for her to see when she next checks.
Dev picks up his phone and sees Ruth's follow-up message.
Ruth checks her phone and sees no new messages from Nina.
Nina picks up her phone and sees the group message from Ruth, Dev's reply, Ruth's follow-up, and Ruth's direct message, all stacked up.
Nina's reply to Ruth's direct message is sent and arrives on Ruth's phone.
Nina's reply arrives on Ruth's phone, available for her to see when she next checks.
Ruth picks up her phone and sees Nina's reply to her direct message.

Ruth reads Nina's reply to her direct message, which says: 'Sorry I've been so slow to reply. Yes, I can do my £200. But I can't cover anyone else's share. If you can sort Dev's part, I'm in. If not, I understand.'
Ruth sends a message to Marian Prowse: 'Hi Marian, sorry but we won't be taking Cove Cottage for half-term. We can't get the deposit together. Thanks for holding it for us.'
Ruth's message arrives on Marian Prowse's phone, available for her to see when she next checks.
Marian Prowse's phone remains in her pocket, unread. She is occupied with other tasks and does not check her phone immediately.
Marian Prowse picks up her phone and sees Ruth's message that they won't take the cottage.
Marian dials the Leeds couple's number. The call connects and rings on their end.
The Leeds couple's phone rings. They answer after a few rings.
